notes.text:
Changes/Bugfixes:
- Fort Joy Ghetto guards will no longer send you to prison if you don't have Fort Joy access
- Act keys and the Level Teleport will no longer be stuck in a chest should your inventory be confiscated
- Several barriers around Fort Joy have been improved
- Fixed being able to teleport to The Hollow Marshes early through the drawbridge
- Fixed typo (Driftwood: Bsaket (419, 789))
- Fixed two crates in Fort Joy coming into logic too early

About [here](https://github.com/Intaiachi/ArchipelagoDOS2/blob/main/worlds/dos2/docs/en_Divinty%20Original%20Sin%202.md)
Setup Guide [here](https://github.com/Intaiachi/ArchipelagoDOS2/blob/main/worlds/dos2/docs/steup_en.md)
